description: This source file contains the class `Topic` within the `Opencart\Admin\Model\Cms` namespace. It manages CRUD operations for CMS topics in the OpenCart backend, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving topics, descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, and other related data.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Class `Topic` manages CMS topic data including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval, along with associated descriptions, store assignments, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Inserts a new topic record into the database, including descriptions, store associations, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates an existing topic record and related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Deletes a topic and all associated descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and cache entries.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific topic, including descriptions and SEO URLs, with caching.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of topics with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topics in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description for a topic in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a particular topic.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations for a specific topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to a topic for a specific store.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Adds SEO URL entries for a topic.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Removes SEO URLs based on a key-value pair.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Fetches SEO URL data for a topic.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrls
methods.description: Deletes SEO URL entries for a topic.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total number of SEO URL entries for topics.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with a topic by inserting into the topic_to_layout table.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a given article ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all topic layout associations for a specific layout ID.
